info.title: Platform admin (السنترال) — live API only
info.not: This is NOT the channel dashboard (guard channel, port 3001).
info.rule: If this file and the catalog disagree, this file wins. Call only live:true. Never call forbidden. Never mock missing GMV/billing/refs-at-contract-path. Keep every moving base path behind ONE constant.

headers.Authorization: Bearer {token} — required except POST /platform/auth/login, POST /platform/auth/2fa/verify, GET /health
headers.Accept-Language: ar — server messages may still be English; map error.code
headers.X-Client: platform-web — sent for logs; server ignores it
headers.X-Idempotency-Key: UUID per user intent on every write except login and 2fa/verify
headers.X-Channel-Id: optional, honoured only for platform_admin when switching tenant context — do not send unless that flow exists

envelope.money: integer minor units. SYP decimals = 0. Never /100. Do not invent GMV.
envelope.sort: roles list allows sort=id|name|created_at. Other lists: never send sort unless this file names it.
envelope.not_found: 404 means missing OR not yours — never render forbidden
envelope.two_gates: permissions[] gate IAM/audit. /admin/channels index+delete also require role platform_admin. Gate::before grants platform_admin every permission.
envelope.moving: stability=moving lives at a temporary path. One constant per base: CHANNELS_BASE=/admin/channels, REFS_GOV=/governorates, REFS_ZONES=/zones, REFS_FX=/currencies.

gotchas: Login expires_at is nominal — Sanctum expiration is null. Trust 401.
2FA challenge_token lives in React state only, 10 minutes, 5 attempts.
PUT /platform/me is a full object (name required). PUT /admin/channels/{id} is partial but reason is required. status is prohibited on channel create/update.
Channel index and DELETE are gated by role platform_admin, not a permission — 403 has no error.permission.
GET /admin/channels/{id} returns nested channel.allowed_next — drive transition buttons from that list.
POST /admin/channels returns 201 {id, status:provisioning, provisioning_job_id}. Status starts provisioning. Do not send status.
POST /admin/channels/{id}/transition and retry-provisioning ARE live on the moving prefix. Limits/usage/coverage/users/warehouses/features/applications/bulk-plan are not.
DELETE /admin/channels/{id} is 204 empty body, soft delete, no restore.
created_at on a channel is UTC; other timestamps are Asia/Damascus.
Replay requires_password_confirm with the SAME idempotency key and body.
POST /me/api-tokens puts the current password in password_confirmation and checks it inline — not the 15-min window.
2fa/enable qr_svg is an empty placeholder — render QR from secret (otpauth URI). Recovery codes appear once on confirm.
POST /iam/assignments partial success is still 200 — render rejected. DELETE /iam/assignments needs a body.
New roles land as draft. Creator cannot approve (403 sod_violation).
approval-requests decide: read executed, not status. Review items use keep|revoke.
GET /iam/reviews/{id} is unpaginated. simulate tenant layer is hardcoded pass.
audit/export body key is filters (plural); the list uses filter. No job-status route.

/governorates /zones /currencies are live at the v1 root on a multi-guard list. Contract path is /platform/refs/*. Do not build admin screens on them without one constant. Shape is thinner than SP-03.
GET /platform/dashboard is 404. Never fake GMV.
GET/PUT /platform/content/intro is catalog only — no route. Channel intro is /channel/content/intro on the other dashboard.

endpoints.name: Health check
endpoints.description: Public liveness. No tenant, no auth.

endpoints.name: Verify 2FA
endpoints.note: Body {challenge_token, code}. Challenge 10 min / 5 attempts. Idempotency exempt.

endpoints.name: Confirm password
endpoints.description: Valid 15 minutes (BR-AD-04). Required before critical actions.
endpoints.note: Opens a 15-minute window used only by PUT /platform/me/password. Replay the original write with the same key.

endpoints.name: Platform login
endpoints.note: Seeded admin has no 2FA → token. With 2FA: {requires_2fa, challenge_token}. Wrong credentials = generic 401. expires_at is nominal.

endpoints.name: Current platform user
endpoints.note: Identical to GET /platform/me.

endpoints.name: Confirm 2FA setup
endpoints.note: 8 recovery codes once. Wrong code 401 otp_invalid, 2FA stays off.

endpoints.name: Start 2FA setup
endpoints.description: BR-AD-03: إلزامي لمدير المنصة ولمن يملك انتحال الجلسة.
endpoints.note: secret is otpauth:// URI. qr_svg is an empty <svg/>. 2FA is not on until confirm.

endpoints.name: 2FA recovery codes
endpoints.description: الرموز نفسها لا تُعاد قراءتها بعد الإنشاء (BR-AD-21).
endpoints.note: Returns codes_remaining only — never the codes again.

endpoints.name: Create API token
endpoints.description: BR-AD-04: تأكيد كلمة المرور. الرمز يُعرض مرة واحدة.
endpoints.note: Current password in password_confirmation. Checked inline, not the 15-min window. Token plaintext once.

endpoints.name: Change my password
endpoints.note: Needs confirm-password window. Replay same idempotency key.

endpoints.name: My platform profile
endpoints.description: DOC-07 §4.12 ملفي الشخصي. متاح لكل أدوار المنصة.

endpoints.name: Update my profile
endpoints.note: Full object — name required even for a one-field edit. Phone is Syrian, normalised server-side.

endpoints.name: Decide dual-approval request
endpoints.description: Approver cannot be the requester.
endpoints.note: Read executed, not status.

endpoints.name: Dual-approval inbox
endpoints.description: DOC-12E TB-AD-007 / AC-PM-05. The 21 dual-approval permissions create a request instead of executing.

endpoints.name: Revoke role assignment
endpoints.note: DELETE with body {user_id, role_id, reason}.

endpoints.name: Assign roles
endpoints.description: Max 50 user_ids per call.
endpoints.note: Max 50 ids. 200 with assigned[] and rejected[].

endpoints.name: Permission holders
endpoints.note: users[].name is "#id". Capped at 50. Not a list envelope.

endpoints.name: Permission catalog
endpoints.note: 133 seeded codes (DOC-08 has 170). Paginated. filter[system] platform|channel|warehouse|app.

endpoints.name: Decide review item
endpoints.description: decision: keep|revoke. DOC-12E TF-AD-115.

endpoints.name: Access-review campaign
endpoints.description: DOC-12E TB-AD-115/153. Campaign cannot close until every item is decided.
endpoints.note: Unpaginated. Item vocabulary keep|revoke.

endpoints.name: Preview role in business language

response.summary_ar: سيستطيع تأكيد الطلبات وتغيير أسعار المناطق

endpoints.description: DOC-12E TB-AD-143.

endpoints.name: Approve role
endpoints.description: Rejected if approver is the creator (SOD-05).
endpoints.note: Creator cannot approve → 403 sod_violation. Never retry.

endpoints.name: Replace role permissions
endpoints.note: Full replacement. Gated on ad.iam.role_create.

endpoints.name: Create role
endpoints.note: 201 status=draft. Grants nothing until a second admin approves.

endpoints.name: Simulate authorization
endpoints.note: tenant layer is hardcoded pass. allowed = guard && (permission || temp-grant) && !sod.

response.reason: لا يجتمع تأكيد الطلب مع تسجيل الدفعة

endpoints.name: Request temp grant

body.reason: تصحيح فاتورة مكررة بعد حادث مزامنة — تذكرة SUP-441

endpoints.description: duration_minutes ≤ 240. reason ≥ 20 chars.
endpoints.note: reason ≥ 20 chars. duration_minutes 1–240. Requester cannot approve.

endpoints.name: Export audit log
endpoints.description: The export itself is audited (REQ-AD-062).
endpoints.note: Body key filters (plural). No status poll. Horizon required.

endpoints.name: Retry provisioning
endpoints.description: Idempotent (REQ-AD-023).
endpoints.note: LIVE on moving prefix. Returns {job_id}. Safe to repeat. No poll route.

endpoints.name: Transition channel status
endpoints.description: Permission is ad.channels.suspend / ad.channels.archive depending on target.
endpoints.note: LIVE on moving prefix. Body {to_status, reason}. 422 unknown state, 409 illegal_transition. Buttons from allowed_next.

endpoints.name: Delete channel
endpoints.description: Archived ≥ 30 days. Dual approval.
endpoints.note: 204 no body. Role platform_admin. Soft delete, no restore.

endpoints.name: Channel detail
endpoints.note: Nested detail with allowed_next, plan, limits, genuine KPI zeros, manager null until BE-T07.

endpoints.name: Update channel profile
endpoints.description: DOC-07 §4.2.7 تبويب نظرة عامة. BR-AD-11: سبب مكتوب إلزامي.
endpoints.note: Partial + required reason. status prohibited — use transition.

endpoints.name: List supply channels
endpoints.note: MOVING. Role platform_admin. page/per_page only — no search. created_at UTC.

endpoints.name: Create channel
endpoints.description: Must respond under 500ms (AC-AD-03). Provisioning is async.
endpoints.note: MOVING. Catalog body (not name+slug only). status prohibited. Lands in provisioning.
